about_the_game: The game simulates the traditional Kong Ming lock game and requires the use of red and blue glasses to experience the game. The concave and convex parts inside this three-dimensional splicing tool are cleverly engaged. There are a total of nine Kongming Lock shapes listed in this game. The specific operation method is to apply force to Kongming Lock components by holding down the left mouse button while moving the mouse, and rotate the perspective by holding down the right mouse button while moving the mouse. Different methods can be used to unlock the lock body. The Kongming Lock in each level is composed of different shaped parts, with multiple green wooden parts and one white wooden part. The green wooden part can be dragged, but the white wooden part cannot be dragged. When all green wooden parts are dragged away from the white wooden part, it is unlocked successfully. Paired with red and blue glasses in left, red, and right blue formats, it can present a three-dimensional effect.
